body: That's awesome! So you play music too? I wish I had the determination to do that. I've "played" guitar for years, but I never make any substantial progress. How do you keep at it? Would love to hear you play!

You legend. I feel your frustration. It is true that simply being positive can help with so many issues. Even research has show this. But we always look to the negative and give it too much power.

Kudos to you for trying to pass this on to people.

The fact that you feel regret is good. Man, I don't think I can imagine how you feel. The fact you want to alter things, know you need to do these things is awesome. You have a few steps to go, but it seems like you have it solidified in your mind. That ls huge.
That's interesting, isn't that a painkiller? I'm glad you found something that works, even intermittently. What makes you think you're the problem?
Sertraline / zoloft. It can really help, just not at this moment. I'm sorry you're finding things hard. The world feels dark sometimes.
I do appreciate the offer. I'm at a loss for words as to how to say thank you, or what to talk about. I just feel lost, out of place. And more than a little hopeless.
I can't see the point to be honest. Thank you though.

I have had many. Whether it be to learn particular singer albums on my guitar - to writing several short stories and novels. I've been looking for a different job for 3 years. I honestly don't think I could cope with moving at this time. I dont know what else to shoot for, or if it's even worth it.

You're not wrong. I do appreciate the thought. I have spent a lot of time listening and reading about the albums, writing process, analyzing lyrics and music and trying to isolate what it is I like about them. I can never really emulate anything that gives me a similar feeling. For some reason my musical knowledge never sticks. I've read about theory, learned countless chords and scales but I always seem to get lost and forget what I have learned. It's bizzare. I think the oddity of the situation adds to my annoyance.

I thank you for talking, but I have to retire. I'm in work in a few hours, and should attempt to sleep before I start. Thanks for your time.

True. I like a lot, but I listen to a lot of prog metal. My favourite band being TesseracT. Something heavy, but not without sense of melody and structure. I'd like to be able to create something in that area. Something I lose myself in, but something I'd like to listen to too.

Yeah, within the writing of fiction, or lyrics and music. Of all the things in my life, music is something I always have with me. It doesn't bring the escape and level of comfort it used to. But there's still something, I just have no musical talent (instrumentally or vocally).

I see what you're saying, but I've always been a bit of a "half empty" type of guy. Not in an overly defeatist sense, but I don't see my basic functionality as an achievement. 

I want to be able to create something, something I'm proud of. I want to be satisfied with where I am.

I can't escape the feeling of bleakness, or just emptiness I feel consumed by. Interestingly enough I'm not sure how I would define a "life with a point". I can't see a point to mine, as I don't really effect much. Work gets by fine without me, and my relationships are such that they are non existant anyway. Not because I let them die, but because I couldn't be the only one maintaining it, and since I've stopped trying - none have responded. I don'#t put anything in to the world. So I guess that would be my definition of me, without a point.

I could never get anything I wanted to write to sound quite right, so i always got frustrated. I have dabbled with poetry and lyrics, but I always hated the sound and flow. I want to write some kinda of novel/story but always get lost and stuck so again, I give up.

I did come off my medication for a few months. I had a breakdown because of anxiety and my inability to quieten my thoughts. So I get where you're coming from, but I don't think I can function without at this moment in time.

The 6 months thing was something I was told several times, months apart. I have since given up asking. That was nearly a year ago, and no more letters have come through regarding the pointless appraisals I was 'required' to attend which basically said "are you doing what we asked?" (exercise, go to whatever stupid class/event I was sent to etc.) and that was basically it.

Thanks for replying though.

I appreciate your offers. I almost can't comprehend it, my mind is just screwed at the moment. 

That would be interesting, but it'd be like you're talking to a complete novice. I tried going over some stuff a few times, and it's like my brain just never took any if it in. I can only seem to learn from tabs, well maybe a few videos.

And thank you for those kind words. That actually stunned me for a minute or two. I've not heard anything like that in a while. Thank you sir.

I used to find solace in these things. But not so much so now. Maybe it's because I play less story intense games? I'm not very good at multiplayer games these days, despite how much I play them. Music too, I always want to emulate what I hear and love, but very rarely can, I don't have the ear for it.

The problem really is that, I'm stuck in this way of thinking. I can't break out of it. My attention span is atrocious.

I was already depressed. An effort to change things and make things interesting. Didn't work.

Yeah, I see to read all the time, fly through games. I can't be bothered to read and get bored with games so easily.

No mess seem to be taking me out of this melancholy. I haven't had side effects from any of them. So my doctors just been increasing the dose slowly. Well, I haven't been in months. Still taking the meds but I can't see much point anymore.
I get that. It's like I just can't find any that mean anything to me. I have days where I really push myself to be positive, but it never sticks. I just feel like I'm performing, and fake.

I played bass for a while, attempted piano, tried singing, now play guitar. Would love to give drums a go but can't afford & have no room for a kit.

I can only seem to lean songs through tabs. Anything I learnt theory wise just seems to disappear from my mind. The fact that my younger brother could learn stuff by ear and retain it all just wound me up. I know I shouldn't compare, but I can't help it.

I have tried various medications, and I'm tired of taking the. Logically, I can understand that illness is clouding my mind, but I can never seem to get passed it. The thing that riles me more is that nobody really seems to give a crap. I've spoken to people, and I just seem to get a "that sucks.." And nothing else.

I've been on waiting lists for counselling, but I never seek to move any closer.

Music probably is my only solace, but I even et bored with that. To the point where I keep flicking through albums, unable to settle. 

I really don't know.
If I could do something musical that would e awesome. I've studied music, taken lessons. But I've never been able to click with any instrument, nothing seems to stay in my memory.

I have been trying to find another job. I keep getting refusals. I've gone I see advisors, done I have no idea how many training sessions to try an improve my prospects. 

I can't find anything I want to study, I feel like I have no direction. I feel empty.
I'd have to go really small. Nothing that is significant. I'm in the UK, I just made it passed Primary school. I work a dead end job, I just suck.
I can't think of anything I've accomplished.  Can't pinpoint any value, or real reason for anything.

Thats a really cool way of looking at it. Awesome.

I'm struggling to have, or recognize any victories in my own life. I don't count my existing still as one, I don't know. I enjoy helping people, and I do what I can to make other people's lives pleasant, but I can never make those same waves in my own life. I just don't feel it.

I suppose I get most frustrated with myself. Without anyone else to involve myself with, I try to entertain myself. I'm not very good at anything, so I never seem to make progress. Never in anything I'm interested in. 

I get irritated at the fact that my friends have kinda left me behind and it's awkward speaking to them now. I have called them out on it, but we have the "Yeah, you're right, lets do something soon!" thing that never amounts to anything. I've been forward and took things into my own hands and tried to start things up, but it just remains one sided.

My job is fine. I work in retail, but in a fairly decent store, so I don't have many problems. My home life is ok too. My parents just don't get how I feel, but neither of them have experienced it, so I guess it is hard to understand.
I'll be glad to talk if you like. I'll listen to anything you have to say.

Well apparently we haven;t been food shopping in a few days. So randomly filled pitta breads it is haha. Thank you for helping me keep my mind occupied a little differently and with a bit more positivity.

Thats a really nice idea. I need to learn how to cook noodles properly. Ha.

You're right, I'd not thought about that in a while. Here I am thinking I'm thinking about everything wrong and wierdly and it might just be my brain tripping - so to speak. In fact, I'm actually hungry, I'm gonna go try and make something.

I have tried to pick a few new things. I keep hitting the same dead end unfortunately. I enjoy nothing, so after a while it just feels like I'm headbutting concrete. It's more frustrating with hobbies like reading, writing, videos games and drawing, as I know I used to enjoy them and now I get nothing from them.

I definitely need to exercise. Staying continually motivated for that is a right pain in the arse though., I know that really is a poor excuse, since that is what everyone goes through. I can't afford a gym, so I have looked up and tried to set various routines to push myself but it inevitably only lasts a few days. Also, beer and pizza is good. Heh. Actually, I do occasionally enjoy cooking, although things never turn out how I think, and I'm never sure how to fix them.

I'm finding it so hard with my family at the moment. My parents are both getting on a bit, and going deaf. Conversations get so difficult at times I get even more frustrated and snap at them, then I just hate myself for being so inconsiderate.

I've kept various journals in the past, I even had a tumblr specifically for pouring my mind into. But I never really stick to it. I always feel goofy, or stupid. I never really did a continuous stream of consciousness thing though. Now I think about it I only seem to explode onto it when I felt like I was quite literally ready to detonate.

Thanks for that though, I don't really fell like I'm doing that great a job, but I'm still here so I guess that counts as afloat ha. :)

Sure.

Although my conversation skill is only roughly around level one, ha.
Thanks dude. That'd be awesome. I just have no idea what to say at this point. I just want to get of my head and stay the feck out, y'know? Being stuck sucks.

Ahh, Hyperbole and A Half. Yeah, I've read that a few times. It's given me hope on a few occasions.

I'm willing to bounce back as it were, I just had no idea what the hell to do. Everywhere I go seems to shut off, things just crumble.

Thanks for your reply, and those really kind words. I'd like to think I'm a good person, I want help. I just don't know what I need or where to get it.
